cards.title: The Operational Last Mile
cards.desc: A production AI system needs source data, validation, approval gates, and an audit trail built around how a product or service is delivered.
cards.receipt: 6 production systems · 1 public pet project · 8 field notes

cards.title: Marco: Infrastructure Before Copy
cards.desc: Marco is an outbound AI agent that begins with sender health, deliverability gates, and signals before it writes a message.
cards.receipt: SPF/DKIM/DMARC · placement tests · 15-minute reply triage · approval gates

cards.title: Hunter: Rules Before Autonomy
cards.desc: Hunter runs persistent PPC operations across Google and Microsoft Ads, but meaningful changes stay governed by written rules and human approval.
cards.receipt: Google Ads + Microsoft Ads · CRM-grounded rules · Telegram approval · action logs

cards.title: Oscar: The Dashboard Is the Wrong Interface
cards.desc: Oscar is a self-hosted YouTube operations agent that turns analytics, SEO, captions, and channel tools into a plain-language interface.
cards.receipt: Self-hosted · multi-channel · dozens of tools · analytics, SEO, captions, reporting

cards.title: InspectPilot: Reputation vs. Record
cards.desc: InspectPilot pairs inspection scheduling with a compliance engine built on roughly 11 million Los Angeles inspection records over 13 years.
cards.receipt: ~11M public records · 13 years · LADBS inspections · first-pass and violation history

cards.title: AI Changed the Build-vs.-Buy Line
cards.desc: A field note on replacing selected SaaS tools with self-hosted systems, where ownership saves money, and where it creates new operating costs.
cards.receipt: 4 named migration paths · Git source of truth · one MCP gateway · tool-level cost logs

cards.title: Behind the Watt: AI With Receipts
cards.desc: Behind the Watt is an open evidence database that uses AI to extract claims from public records while preserving source-level provenance and human approval.
cards.receipt: 3 facilities · 1.03 verified operating GW · 143.3 reported GW separate · source provenance

cards.title: The Operating Principle
cards.desc: A production pattern for AI systems: let software handle persistence and volume, keep consequential decisions with people, and log every action.
cards.receipt: Explicit rules · human approval gates · audit logs · source evidence
